race.comment: HIGH AMBITIONS (1) is a former Victorian who was well in the market on debut this area but jumped well back and was back and wide throughout. Better for the experience and change of rider. Well worth another chance. BOSS SHELBY (4) has been freshened since disappointing last time. Nicely weighted and gets a chance to atone. REVOLUTION RISING (2) is close to a win with back-to-back placings and will be close to the speed. Close to a win and will take bearing off the low draw. SNICK (5) is fitter for one run back and will be much improved on first try this area. BONNY IMPACT (3) is overdue and looks one of the chances.
